drill.audience: Just the coach — read it like you're telling it to a friend, not announcing it.
constraints: No restarts — keep going through stumbles
When you stumble or the next word isn't ready, pause a full second instead of repeating the last phrase
drill.name: Read Aloud
principles: Slow down on what's important; one default speed flattens everything
Fillers are discomfort with silence made audible — practice the pause and they starve
End sentences on a low pitch — down sounds certain, up sounds unsure
drill.prompt: Read a paragraph of your choice aloud for 60 seconds.

fix_carried_forward: Pause 1s instead of repeating the phrase
